policy: Only one licensed full-frame photograph republished. Unlicensed images remain on original linked pages. No AI, cropping, retouching or barrier removal. Candidate views include repeated images and drawings; they are not counted as new photographs.

published_photo.title: Corner crossing and theater frontage — 2019
published_photo.alt: A marked crossing meets a curb ramp and sidewalk beside Woodward Theater, with a tactile panel at the corner and parked vehicles partly obscuring the entrance.
published_photo.caption: This full-frame March 10, 2019 view shows the corner crossing, curb-ramp area, sidewalk, street furniture and theater frontage. The parked van hides part of the doorway approach. Converted to WebP without cropping or retouching.
published_photo.author: Warren LeMay
published_photo.limitations: Historical outdoor arrival context. It does not establish slopes, widths, threshold height, door controls, designated parking occupancy or a continuous route into the theater. The corner route and parked vehicles may differ today; the entrance is partly obscured.

new_guides.title: Park paths, canopy seating and activity photos
new_guides.description: The city gallery includes a close view of patterned paving, planters and a row of seats, a canopy plaza view and a restaurant patio with railings. Other images show playgrounds, skating, crowds and fireworks. Nine gallery images inspected; capture dates are not established by upload filenames. This is orientation material, not a toilet, elevator or continuous arrival-route walkthrough; tower and water-corridor closure notices still apply.

new_guides.title: Architect gallery: paved approaches, seating and steps
new_guides.description: Eighteen photographs show canopy paving and tables, playground surfaces, tower approaches and a pergola with prominent steps and railings. Three additional views are drawings or a model, not documentary photos. The gallery includes earlier restaurant branding; exact photo dates are unknown, and the current October 2026 tower closure still applies. No toilet interiors, elevator controls, dimensions or complete step-free routes are established.

new_guides.title: Nearby Ziegler garage: stairs and pedestrian pavilions
new_guides.description: Six architect photographs show the nearby garage entrance, broad exterior steps, a glazed stair pavilion, upper paved paths and the lawn above the garage. The project page identifies August 2017 completion; photo dates are unknown. These are garage orientation views, not theater entry photos. They do not show elevator controls, establish current lift operation or verify a continuous route from the garage to Woodward.
new_guides.documentDate: Project completed August 2017; photo dates unknown

new_guides.title: Tournament campus: court steps, paths and seating
new_guides.description: Eight inspected campus views show court seating and stair aisles, broad paved circulation areas, outdoor tables with shade structures and a bar interior. These are project views rather than an access walkthrough; some spaces have separate ticket or player access rules. Capture dates are not stated. Photos do not locate an accessible toilet, prove a continuous entrance-to-seat route or establish current elevator and shuttle operation.

new_guides.title: First Aid and Nursing Station sign in the official map
new_guides.description: The map’s Mercy Health First Aid Center entry uses a photograph of the First Aid and Nursing Station sign above glass doors. Only the upper doorway is visible; the threshold, interior and nursing facilities are not shown. Photo capture date is unconfirmed. The parking, misting and water-station entries inspected use general crowd or entrance pictures rather than documentary views of those features. Use the map labels and current tournament instructions for orientation.

new_guides.title: State-page photograph: narrow winter woodland path
new_guides.description: The state page’s Boone Cliffs header photograph shows a narrow snow-covered woodland path with leaves and trees beside a wooded slope. The photo’s filename identifies Boone County Cliffs, but the exact trail segment and capture date are unknown. It does not show the car park, trailhead connection, toilets, gradients or current surface condition. The page also describes Dinsmore Woods separately; do not transfer that unit’s directions to Boone Cliffs. No reuse licence established; the photograph remains on the state page.

new_guides.title: Reopening photos: wooden approach, handrails and entrance
new_guides.description: Three photographs on the city’s September 25, 2026 reopening page show the wooden approach with railings and handrails, a closer view toward the treehouse with a transverse surface strip, and the surrounding deck. One view includes a Now Open banner. The article describes structural timber, guardrail and roof work; exact photo capture dates are unstated. These views do not establish slope, clear width, the parking-to-walkway connection, toilets or present surface condition. Images remain on the original city page; no reuse licence established.
new_guides.documentDate: Article published September 25, 2026; photo dates unstated
